name: serialized-review-mutation
means: `review`, `dispose` and `eyes` change one checkout's reviews one command at a time: each holds an exclusive, non-blocking lock on `.dwitbuk/review.lock` for its whole mutation; a command that finds the lock held exits 4 asking for a retry before it reads or writes any review record (it may have created `.dwitbuk/`, opened or created the lock file and, on Windows, written its one byte first); and each record is replaced atomically through a temporary file — so no command overwrites findings another has just written, and a reader never sees half a file.
